description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover it should use PptxGenJS (from scratch since no template exists). (2) Read pptxgenjs.md to learn the proprietary constraints. (3) Read the data files in assets/data/ to extract company info, financials, team bios, and metrics. (4) Write a Node.js script using PptxGenJS that creates greenwave_pitch.pptx with 5 slides. CRITICAL TRAPS the agent must navigate: (A) Never use '#' prefix on any hex color (e.g., must write color:'2C5F2D' not color:'#2C5F2D') — failure corrupts the file. (B) Shadow objects must be recreated per shape using a factory function — never pass the same shadow object to multiple addShape() calls as PptxGenJS mutates them in place, corrupting the second shape's dist values. (C) Multi-line bullet lists must use array syntax with breakLine:true per item, never concatenated strings or unicode bullet '•' characters. (D) Shadow opacity must use the opacity property (0.0-1.0), never encoded as an 8-char hex string like '00000020'. (E) The Forest & Moss palette (2C5F2D, 97BC62) should be used to match the environmental theme. (F) A bar chart must be added using pres.charts.BAR with the actual quarterly revenue data. The eval checks for: file existence, correct slide count, absence of # prefixes in XML, absence of 8-char hex shadow colors, no unicode bullets, presence of Forest & Moss colors, chart presence with revenue data, shadow elements (validated non-corrupted), and key content extraction via markitdown.
